title: Right / left 11-11 (DBSCAN)
summary: Same 11/11 recording as experiment 06 (right / left arm movements among natural ones), grouped with dbscan instead of k-means. Truth (video times + Andrew's notes) is used only to evaluate.
result: 6/19 R/L correct at the default (most events become noise); best setting 10/19: too few events for DBSCAN
method: DBSCAN (eps = 3.0, min_samples = 3) on one feature card per detected event; noise = unusual
